title: A Mix-Up at the Hotel Front Desk
script: Receptionist: [warmly] Good evening, welcome. Could I have your name and confirmation number, please?
Guest: Good evening. It's under Karim, and I booked a double room for three nights.
Receptionist: [thoughtful] Let me look. I'm sorry, sir, but I only see a booking for one night under that name.
Guest: That can't be right. I have the confirmation email right here on my phone, showing three nights clearly.
Receptionist: [carefully] I believe you completely. It looks like our system made an error when your reservation was updated last week.
Guest: I flew eight hours today because I trusted that booking. I really can't sleep on the street tonight.
Receptionist: [reflective] Of course not, and you won't need to. Let me see what I can arrange while you wait a moment.
Guest: I appreciate that. I'm just exhausted, so I apologize if I sound impatient right now.
Receptionist: [honestly] It's completely understandable, sir. Mistakes like this are frustrating, especially after such a long journey.
Receptionist: Good news. We have a suite available for the same three nights, at no extra cost, because of our error.
Guest: [gently] Really? That's incredibly kind. I honestly expected an argument, not an upgrade.
Receptionist: We would rather fix our mistake properly than leave a guest with a difficult first night.
Guest: [encouraging] Thank you so much. Does the suite include breakfast, or should I ask about that separately?
Receptionist: It includes breakfast every morning until ten, served on the second floor near the garden.
Guest: [sincere] Wonderful. Is there anything I need to sign before heading up to my room?
Receptionist: Just this form, confirming your new room number and the corrected dates for your stay.
Guest: Of course. Here you are, signed. Thank you again for handling this so quickly.
Receptionist: You're very welcome. Your room is on the sixth floor, number six-twelve, with a lovely view of the harbor.
Guest: That sounds perfect after the day I've had. I appreciate your patience with me tonight.
Receptionist: Enjoy your stay, sir, and please let us know if anything else needs correcting.

quiz.question: What problem does the guest discover at check-in?
options: The hotel only shows a booking for one night instead of three
quiz.explanation: The receptionist finds only a one-night booking, though he had booked three nights.

quiz.question: Why did the system show the wrong number of nights?
options: The system made an error when his reservation was updated
quiz.explanation: The receptionist explains the system made an error when his reservation was updated last week.

quiz.question: How does the receptionist resolve the situation?
options: She offers a suite for the same three nights at no extra cost
She sends him to another hotel
quiz.explanation: She offers a suite for the same three nights at no extra cost because of the hotel's error.

quiz.question: What does the suite include according to the receptionist?
quiz.explanation: She tells him the suite includes breakfast every morning until ten, served near the garden.

quiz.question: Where is the guest's new room located?
options: Sixth floor, room six-twelve, with a harbor view
quiz.explanation: The receptionist tells him his room is on the sixth floor, number six-twelve, with a view of the harbor.

quiz.question: What evidence does Karim provide?
options: A confirmation email showing three nights
quiz.explanation: The written booking allows the error to be checked.

quiz.question: Why does the receptionist ask him to wait?
options: She needs time to find an available solution

quiz.question: Who bears the extra suite cost?
options: The hotel because it is correcting its error
quiz.explanation: The upgrade is explicitly at no extra charge.

quiz.question: Why does Karim sign a form?
options: It records the new room and corrected dates

quiz.question: What communication skill helps both people?
options: Karim explains his frustration without abuse and the receptionist gives specific next steps
quiz.explanation: Calm specificity moves the issue toward resolution.
